newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bourse seen cautious ahead of jobs data.
newsitem.headline: French bourse seen cautious ahead of jobs data.

text.p: Paris stocks were indicated higher in early futures market trading but brokers said the market would be cautious on Friday ahead of the U.S. May jobs figures due on in the afternoon.
Some said it was due a consolidation after five days of gains but prices were underpinned on Friday by firmer bond prices and a stronger dollar.
* CAC-40 June futures contract up four at 2,688 at 0730 GMT
* CAC-40 index closed up 2.11 pct at 2,690.85 on Thursday
* Pernod-Ricard set to buy Spanish gin maker Larios for 1.4 billion francs, according to Les Echos
